welcome.title: A peaceful base for pilgrims, families and travellers
welcome.p1: Hotel Arasan Sapthagiri sits in Anna Nagar, overlooking the city of the Meenakshi Amman Temple. It is a place to rest, to worship and to feel looked after — from the moment you arrive until you check out.
welcome.p2: Families visiting Aravind Eye Hospital, pilgrims and business travellers choose us for clean, quiet rooms, honest service and a location that keeps the whole city within easy reach.

about.title: Hospitality in the heart of the temple city
about.lead: A family-friendly hotel in Anna Nagar, Madurai, close to Aravind Eye Hospital and the Meenakshi Amman Temple.

story.title: Rest, worship and feel at home
story.p2: With 31 air-conditioned rooms, a rooftop restaurant and a team that is available around the clock, we take care of the little things so that your visit to Madurai is calm and easy.
story.p3: Whether you are here for treatment at Aravind Eye Hospital, for darshan at the Meenakshi Amman Temple or for business, you will find a warm welcome and a quiet room waiting for you.

temples.name: Madurai Temple Darshan
temples.tagline: The great temples of Madurai and two of Lord Murugan’s six abodes.

heritage.name: Madurai Heritage Trail
heritage.tagline: Palaces, museums and festival tanks of the ancient Pandya capital.

rameswaram.name: Rameswaram Pilgrimage
rameswaram.tagline: A sacred island journey across the sea to the land’s end at Dhanushkodi.

kodaikanal.name: Kodaikanal Hill Escape
kodaikanal.tagline: Cool air, lakes and valley views in the “Princess of Hill Stations”.

meenakshi.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
meenakshi.text: The heart of Madurai, famed for its towering, colourful gopurams.

thiruparankundram.name: Thiruparankundram
thiruparankundram.text: Rock-cut hill temple of Lord Murugan — the first of his six abodes.

alagarKovil.name: Alagar Kovil
alagarKovil.text: Vishnu temple at the foot of the Alagar hills, north of the city.

pazhamudircholai.name: Pazhamudircholai
pazhamudircholai.text: Murugan shrine in the forested hills above Alagar Kovil.

nayakkarMahal.name: Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal
nayakkarMahal.text: 17th-century palace known for its giant pillars and grand courtyard.

gandhiMuseum.name: Gandhi Memorial Museum
gandhiMuseum.text: A museum on Gandhi’s life, set in a historic palace.

teppakulam.name: Vandiyur Mariamman Teppakulam
teppakulam.text: A huge temple tank, home of Madurai’s famous Float Festival.

koodalAzhagar.name: Koodal Azhagar Temple
koodalAzhagar.text: Ancient Vishnu temple with a beautiful multi-tiered tower.

ramanathaswamy.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple
ramanathaswamy.text: One of the twelve Jyotirlingas, with India’s longest temple corridors.

pambanBridge.name: Pamban Bridge
pambanBridge.text: The sea bridge linking Rameswaram island to the mainland.

dhanushkodi.name: Dhanushkodi
dhanushkodi.text: The ghost town at the island’s tip, where two seas meet.

kalamMemorial.name: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial
kalamMemorial.text: Memorial to the former President, a son of Rameswaram.

kodaiLake.name: Kodai Lake
kodaiLake.text: Star-shaped lake for boating, cycling and walks along the shore.

coakersWalk.name: Coaker’s Walk
coakersWalk.text: Cliff-side walkway with sweeping views over the valley.

bryantPark.name: Bryant Park
bryantPark.text: Botanical garden known for its flowers and glasshouse.

pillarRocks.name: Pillar Rocks
pillarRocks.text: Three giant granite pillars rising from the misty valley.
